name: unagi
description: Achieve total workflow awareness: track active sprints, checklists, reminders, scratchpad notes, and focus timer directly in your sidebar.

commands.title: UNAGI: Open in Editor Tab (more room for your companion)
UNAGI: Create Custom Character from a Photo
UNAGI: Toggle Desktop Companion (roams your whole screen)

unagi.reminderIntervalMinutes.description: Interval (in minutes) for checking pending high-priority sprint task reminders.

unagi.companion.enabled.description: Show the roaming companion character that delivers alerts and task notifications.

enumDescriptions: Roam everywhere: across the whole view or screen, perching on things.
Walk left and right along the floor, like a character in a side-scrolling game.

unagi.desktopCompanion.enabled.markdownDescription: Let the companion roam your whole screen in a small always-on-top window (Windows only). Very lightweight (~25 MB RAM, near-zero CPU). Replaces the in-view companion while on.

unagi.companion.character.markdownDescription: Character id of your companion (`croagunk`, `kurta`, or any folder you add under `media/sprites`). Easiest to change with the **UNAGI: Choose Companion Character** command.

unagi.water.enabled.description: Remind you to drink water: the companion speaks up and a notification appears.

unagi.water.intervalMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) the water reminder appears.

unagi.quotes.enabled.description: Let the companion speak a random quote now and then.

unagi.quotes.intervalMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) the companion shares a quote.

unagi.quotes.online.markdownDescription: Fetch fresh quotes from free online sources ([ZenQuotes.io](https://zenquotes.io), then DummyJSON). Only the quote request is sent. Turn off to use the built-in list only.

unagi.enableTaskReminders.description: Enable periodic notification reminders for pending sprint tasks.
